change.title: whisper-1 and gpt-4o transcribe models plus /v1/audio/translations shut down Feb 26, 2027; migrate to gpt-transcribe or gpt-live-transcribe (translations to v1/realtime/translations)

source.quote: On August 26, 2026, we notified developers using `whisper-1`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, and `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize` of their deprecation and removal from the API on February 26, 2027.

callSites.notes: backfill(ctx.store) from lib/lab/gen/embed.ts; OPENAI_EMBED_URL is defined at lib/lab/gen/embed.ts:22. The call is inside the lib function; the URL constant was not checked against the request code line by line, so confirm in embed.ts.
runNetworkCheck -> lib/lab/setup/health.ts:91 verifies the OpenAI key by fetching the whisper-1 model.
runNetworkChecks -> lib/lab/setup/health.ts:91 on save of the OpenAI key.

transcribe(); OPENAI_STT_URL at line 24 unless opts.url. Reads text, duration and language from the verbose_json body. Non-ok becomes SttError. Key via resolveSttKey (lib/connectors/apify.ts). Caller: scripts/lab-sync.ts analyse() via sttClientFromCreds (line 103) and the lab pipeline.

openaiEmbedder. Reads data[].embedding by index and usage.total_tokens. Non-ok throws. Reached via activeEmbedder only when LAB_EMBED_PROVIDER=openai, a key, the embed line is on and not dry; the spend gate (gatedCall, lines 180 and 220) wraps it.
openai.auth health check; only checks status (200 ok, 401 refused, 404 no whisper-1 access). Body not read.

task.notes: The lab speech-to-text pipeline (openai-stt.ts transcribe, used by scripts/lab-sync.ts analyse) is hard-wired to whisper-1, which shuts down on February 26, 2027. Migrate it to gpt-transcribe. The migration agent must check that the replacement model supports response_format=verbose_json and still returns the text, duration and language fields that transcribe() reads; the gpt-4o transcribe family only supported json/text. Point the health check at a model that will keep existing, or at GET /v1/models. Embeddings (text-embedding-3-small) are not affected.

callSites.why: POST /v1/audio/transcriptions with model=whisper-1 and response_format=verbose_json. whisper-1 is removed on 2027-02-26, so every transcription will fail with SttError.
The openai.auth health check GETs /v1/models/whisper-1. Once the model is removed this returns 404, and the check will report 'no whisper-1 access' even when the key is valid.
Runs the whisper-1 model probe through runNetworkCheck.
Runs the whisper-1 model probe when the OpenAI key is saved, so the key save will appear to fail.
